justification: Inspected `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/PreferencesActivity.java`, `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/PreferencesFragment.java`, and `android/res/xml/preferences.xml`. `PreferencesActivity` is a thin 72-line host class with only one behavior method (`onCreate`) that swaps in `PreferencesFragment`, plus shared preference key constants; it does not contain multiple cohesive responsibilities or a large method set. The actual preference UI logic, validation, and change handling live in `PreferencesFragment`, so the class itself is not insufficiently modularized.
